subject: Game Theory
title: Strategic Complements and Substitutes
description: A short lesson to help you apply Strategic Complements and Substitutes.

hook.text: If your rival cuts prices, should you follow or hold? The answer depends on compliance and substitution.

buildup.text: Strategic complements: when your rival does more, your best response is to do more too. Arms races.

discovery.text: Strategic substitutes: when your rival does more, your best response is to do less. Quantity competition.

twist.text: Price competition tends to be complementary (everyone matches cuts). Quantity competition is substitutive.

climax.text: Knowing which type of game you're in determines whether to match, undercut, or hold your ground.

punchline.text: Match or diverge? Know your game type.

quiz.question: What are strategic complements?
options: When doing more prompts rivals to also do more
